measurement: Partial directly timestamped wall-clock windows, not reconstructed human effort.
limitations: Network/tool latency is included. The final cross-context interval also includes implementation, so it must not be treated as pure review cost.
Some follow-up reads fell outside timed windows; elapsed intervals are not total review time.
Prior batch did not instrument equivalent windows. No speedup or cost-per-record comparison is supported.
